label: Teltonika RUT301
description: Industrial wired Ethernet router: 1x 100 Mbps WAN, 4x 100 Mbps LAN.
notes: Vendor figures from the RUT301 datasheet: **1x WAN port 10/100 Mbps** and **4x LAN ports, 10/100 Mbps**. Five ports and **fast Ethernet on every one** - this is a wired-only router for an industrial cabinet, and a 1 Gbps circuit on the far side of it runs at 100 Mbps.
